task.title: Testing an Endpoint
task.shortdesc: This section describes the guidelines for testing a request.

context.p: This section describes the guidelines for testing a request.
You can use a third-party client to test the OtoSense™ SMS REST API. For example, curl, Postman, or Advanced REST Client.
To test the endpoints using Postman:

step.cmd: Download the OpenAPI specifications. For more information, see API Standards.
Select the OpenAPI specifications Swagger JSON file.

result.p: The OpenAPI will be added to your collection. You can test the various methods.
You can also test the OtoSense™ SMS REST API from the OtoSense™ SMS API Sandbox or Production tenants.
If you test from the Production tenant, remember that you are working with live production data, not sample or test data.
